title: Honse Racing
description: Adds the horses from Honse Racing to Minecraft!
body:
Adds the horses from [Honse Racing](https://www.roblox.com/games/98594830805998) to Minecraft! Rename any horse (including skeleton horses) to turn them into a honse! 

Credit to the creators of the roblox game, I just made the textures for this pack

REQUIRES [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) OR OPTIFINE


<details>
<summary>List of names (not case sensitive)</summary>
